out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observe a colander store on the main cook line hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Discontinue storing equipment in or on the handsink. It is only to be used for handwashing. The PIC moved the colander during the inspection to correct.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked rice in the hot holding unit was not being held hot enough at 116º, 115º, 113º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. This was a violation during the last routine inspection. At that time, the PIC stated they would turn up the holding temperature of the unit, but learned it dried the rice out. To correct this, they put the rice on time as a public health control. The rice is discarded at 3pm and 8 pm daily. The rice was discarded during today’s inspection. A TPHC procedure will be created and added to the record at the follow-up.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: foods in the right-hand prep unit were not being held at 41º F and below. Hard boiled eggs were 50º, cooked steak was 46º, and kimchi was 51º. The ambient temperature of the unit was 45º. Foods in the single door refrigerator were not being held cold enough. Noodles were 58º, cut lettuce was 50º, and sesame dressing was 60º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The eggs, cooked steak, kimchi, noodles, and cut lettuce were discarded. The sesame dressing was not TCS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Reminder
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without a reminder statement: during the inspection, sunnyside eggs were observed being served on a dish of pork belly kimchi fried rice and stone bowl bibimbap. Undercooked eggs do not appear on the menu and there is no consumer advisory reminder statement.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a reminder statement that includes asterisking (*) the animal-derived foods requiring disclosure to a footnote that states one of the following: 1) 'Regarding the safety of these items, written information is available upon request', or 2) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness', or 3) 'Consuming raw or undercooked meats, seafood, shellfish, or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness, especially if you have certain medical conditions'. Add the undercooked eggs to the menu and include one of the reminder statements shown above. Correct within10 days or by July 23 2026.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: during the inspection, sunnyside eggs were observed being served on a dish of pork belly kimchi fried rice and stone bowl bibimbap. Undercooked eggs do not appear on the menu and there and there is no disclosure statement, as required.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. Undercooked eggs must be added to the menu and must clearly stated the eggs are served raw or undercooked. The EHS explained this requirement to the PIC. Correct within 10 days, or by Thursday, July 23.

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: during the inspection, sunnyside eggs were observed being served on a dish of pork belly kimchi fried rice and stone bowl bibimbap. Undercooked eggs do not appear on the menu and there is no consumer advisory disclosure statement either.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Identifying Information
violations.observation: Observed that containers of poisonous and toxic materials or personal care items do not have legible manufacturer's labels. The label to one bottle of bleach had been removed or fallen off. The label for a second bottle was falling off.
violations.corrective_action: All containers of poisonous and toxic materials or personal care items shall bear a legible manufacturer's label to prevent accidental contamination of food and food contact surfaces. The PIC labeled the bottles during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Large containers of food ingredients were stored on the floor under the prep table in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing foods on the floor. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the ambient temperature of the right prep unit was 45º and foods in it were not being held cold enough. The ambient temperature of the one glass door unit was 50º and foods in it were not being held cold enough.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. The PIC adjusted the holding temperature of the units to try and lower them. The PIC will call to have the units serviced. Ensure the units are serviced as soon as possible. Contact your EHS when they are serviced and working properly. Follow-up is required for this.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. An unapproved splitter was installed on the mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. The PIC removed the splitter during the inspection to correct. If you decide you need a splitter, purchase and install a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has a copy of the 2025 food permit, but it was not posted in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. Locate the 2026 permit and post it in a location where customers can see it. Puzukan Tan Korean Grill (Inspection Date: 01/14/2026) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' The manager was not familiar with the employee health policy requirement.
violations.corrective_action: The inspector provided the manager with copies of the health department model employee health policy documents and forms. All employee present during the inspection were issued the employee signature forms. Have them read and sign the forms. Make sure other employees who handle food, servers included since they cook the food, who were not present during the inspection complete the forms too. Keep the forms readily available for future reference. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the hand washing sink in the dishwashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The manager provided hand soap at the sink during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed a large tea pot full of water in the hand sink in the warewashing area.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. Discontinue using the handsink for tea water. Handsinks are only for washing hands and no other purpose. The manager moved the tea pot. CDI.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were no paper towels at the handsink in the dish washing area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. The inspector tested the chlorine concentration of the machine several times and tried priming the pump, but the reading was 0 ppm chlorine after each attempt.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. Have the unit serviced and contact the inspector when the machine is fixed. Puzukan Tan Korean Grill (Inspection Date: 01/14/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: white rice in a hot holding cabinet was 116ºF. The ambient temperature of the unit as 110º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Cooked rice and all other cooked foods must be held hot at 135º and above. The inspector discussed this with the manager as well as remedies to include increasing the ambient temperature of the hot holding unit to 160º or putting the rice on the time as a public health control agreement. The manager chose to make the hot holding unit hotter by turning up the heat to keep the rice 135º and above. The manager reheated the rice to 135ºF. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: kimchi and cut lettuce in the glass door refrigerator in the kitchen was 44º and 45º, respectively.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The items were placed in the walk-in freezer to cool.

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: ready to eat food prepared on site such as the thin radish dish were not being date- marked.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. The inspector discussed the date marking requirement with the CFM and the owner. CDI.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: a large frozen piece or pieces of beef were observed being thawed at room temperature on the food prep tables.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. The inspector discussed these requirements with the certified food manager and the owner.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed containers of food stored on the floor under the kitchen prep tables, packaged food stored on the freezer floor, and a bag of onions stored on the walk-in floor. Observed a tray of pork belly stored uncovered and under the refrigeration unit in the walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Discontinue storing foods directly on the floor. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection (in 6 months). The certified food manager covered the pork belly during the inspection.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints. One of the servers was not wearing a hair restraint. Anyone who prepares or cooks food must wear a hair restraint while doing so. Servers cook food for the guest, so they need to wear a hair restraint.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. Have all servers and food employees wear hair restraints as soon as possible and before the next routine inspection, in 6 months.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Correct as soon as possible and before the next routine inspection in 6 months.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: bowls.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC sanitized items manually in 3 compartment sink.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Observed dish machine sanitizer below 50 ppm due to chlorine storage receptacle being empty.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. PIC set up 3 compartment sink with adequate sanitizer. During inspection, PIC was able to provide adequate chemical sanitizer for dish machine.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed cooked rice noodles and vegetables on shelf above 2 dr prep #3 at 104-113F; rice in table top warmer near freezer at 112F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC will keep aforementioned items for the remainder of 4 hours, after which PIC will discard items. EHS provided time as a public health control guidance.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed bean sprouts (47F), kimchi (47F), cooked spinach (49F), cooked beans (47F) in 2 dr prep top #2 at cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded items.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: observed frozen raw beef thawing on prep surface of cook line at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC moved item to fridge to thaw.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed stainless steel container without a handle stored in dried rice container as scoop.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed container. EHS instructed PIC to use scoop with handle.
